core_obligations: The authors construct sparse low-rank corrections for generalized Walsh-Hadamard matrices, use smooth-prime number theory and factor-block decompositions to handle arbitrary Fourier orders, and combine tensor factors at multiple scales to obtain a uniform bound for every sufficiently large finite abelian group. These explicit nonrigidity constructions and parameter bookkeeping remain the residual research work. Circulant diagonalization consequences and finite-field variants remain complete context, not extra counts.
